_about: Spec 03 guard 12 (display parity) fixture, shared by every surface that prints a backtest run's range. One completed run whose window is half-open on the wire: end_exclusive (2026-09-23) is the first day NOT covered, last_bar (2026-09-22) the last day that was. Every renderer - the app (window-parity.unit.test.ts), the SDK _window_line, the backtest card and the compare card - must print `expected`. `served_last_bar` is a second run whose engine-stamped last_bar is EARLIER than end_exclusive - 1 day, proving a renderer reads last_bar rather than re-deriving it.
